title: Compact Transit Pane — Microdeck for fast workspace pivot and contextual cost lens
creator: Lena Chen
description: Problem: Workspace switching and quick model/route visibility in the current Console sidebar is slow and heavyweight for power users who need rapid context pivots while assessing token cost implications. Goals: 1) Create a lightweight, discoverable 'Transit Pane' that overlays the current surface for quick workspace switch and route selection without a full context reload. 2) Surface a compact cost lens (per-route token estimate + recent spend) inline so engineers can make fast trade-offs when moving between models or environments. 3) Ensure accessibility, keyboard-first flows, and low rendering cost on mobile and low-powered machines. Scope: prototype microdeck interactions, keyboard shortcuts, animation guidelines, telemetry hooks, and rollout plan (feature flag + canary). Out of scope: deep billing UI replacement, dedicated capacity contract flows.
acceptance_criteria: Transit Pane opens via keyboard hotkey (Ctrl+K) and a workspace icon shortcut; pane animates within 120ms and is dismissible with Esc.
Users can switch workspace and route within the pane with 2 or fewer interactions; selected route shows per-token estimate and 24h spend ballpark.
Cost lens chips use micro-visuals (sparkline + numeric) and degrade gracefully when telemetry is unavailable.
Prototype validated with 6 engineers and 4 PMs; at least 80% find switching faster in moderated task tests.
Design spec includes a11y notes (focus trap, ARIA roles, contrast ratios), motion limits, and fallback for reduced-motion preferences.
Engineering has committed an integration plan for feature flagging and metric events (transit.open, transit.select, transit.dismiss).
Rollout runbook for a 10% canary with automatic rollback on error-rate/regression signals present in the spec.
Figma and prototype links embedded and comments resolved or addressed in follow-up tickets.
